title: Satellite thermal anomalies
note: A FIRMS hotspot is a satellite-detected thermal anomaly with a confidence and an acquisition time; it is not a confirmed fire and never a confirmed structure fire.
reason: The owner gets a FIRMS MAP_KEY (H09) and stores it as NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY in .env, then T075 is re-run against the documented area API; or a key-free FIRMS download link is read from a rendered FIRMS page (browser) and recorded with its terms.

title: Registered real-estate projects
note: Public project records only; promoter names and personal contacts are never shown.
reason: The owner asks K-RERA for permission to reproduce the project list (copyright policy, by email) and records the reply; then T081 is re-run. Promoter names stay excluded either way.

title: Building footprints
note: Machine-detected footprints (Open Buildings v3, May 2023 imagery) with model confidence, 0.75 or more by default; not a building register.

title: Registered crime, district-year totals
note: Registered cases, not crime incidence: under-reporting varies by offence, place and year. Police units are not revenue districts, so the totals are listed, not mapped.
